svg.title: What the demo sets up
svg.desc: You run bash demo/seed.sh. It generates the secret key of Paperless and the passwords of the demo into demo/.env, and starts Paperless-ngx with Redis and Nextcloud with its background jobs in Docker, on 127.0.0.1 alone. Paperless reads five synthetic letters. Paperless Sync, from the App Store, writes each one into the files of the archive account paperless, which shares the archive read-only with jamie. occ paperless_unified_search:setup connects the app to Paperless, with the API token through a pipe. A search as jamie for invoice shows three Paperless documents, and the script prints the addresses and the accounts to sign in with.
